errors.evidence: The description identifies the figure only as a pie chart and completely fails to mention the stacked bar chart on the right, which provides a detailed breakdown of the 'Renewable energy' category.

errors.text_span: Осата x е ориентирана по посока на часовниковата стрелка и важи от 0% до 100%, като етикетите са разположени равномерно. Осата y е ориентирана по посока на часовниковата стрелка и важи от 0% до 100%, като етикетите са разположени равномерно.
errors.evidence: The description invents x and y axes for the pie chart. Pie charts do not have such axes.

errors.text_span: Сегментът с най-голям размер е “Geothermal” с 58,9%, следван от “Wind” с 34.2%, “Hydro” с 12.7%, “Solid fossil fuels” с 18.3%, “Nuclear energy” с 30.8%, “Renewable energy” с 9.3%, “Crude oil” с 3.9% и “Other” с 3.4%.
errors.evidence: This sentence completely misrepresents the data by mixing and matching labels and values from the pie chart and the separate stacked bar chart. For example, it assigns the value 58.9% (which belongs to 'Bioenergy & waste' in the bar chart) to 'Geothermal' (which is 3.1%). It also assigns the value 34.2% (which belongs to 'Renewable energy') to 'Wind' (which is 12.7%). Multiple such errors make the data reporting entirely incorrect.

errors.evidence: The source information is located at the bottom of the figure, not at the top ('в горната част').
